name: Echo
author: T3 Tools
description: Test fixture that exercises the plugin worker protocol.

operations.name: ping
operations.title: Ping
operations.description: Returns the message it was given and who called it.

operations.name: pong
operations.title: Pong
operations.description: Increments the pong counter and publishes it on the ticks topic.

operations.name: spawn_child
operations.title: Spawn child
operations.description: Spawns a sleeping child process and returns its pid. An untracked child outlives onStop.

operations.name: log
operations.title: Log
operations.description: Writes the requested number of numbered lines to the worker log.

operations.name: crash
operations.title: Crash
operations.description: Exits the worker process with code 3 without answering.

operations.name: big
operations.title: Big result
operations.description: Returns a result whose data field has the requested number of characters.

operations.name: asset
operations.title: Asset
operations.description: Materializes the embedded hello.txt and returns its path and text.
